events.summary: 塔拉辛当面拒绝出席处决，说她绝不坐着看同胞被集体处死。
events.quote: “I’m not going to watch a mass execution,” she said, shaking her head. “No, you can’t make me.”

events.summary: 阿拉里克回答说，若他违抗盖赫里斯，父亲的怒火就会落到塔拉辛身上。
events.quote: “If I refuse him,” said Alaric, “he will take his anger out on you. That is something I cannot allow.”

events.summary: 阿拉里克承诺会让她的人死得干脆，只求她别做出引人注目的举动。
events.quote: “I can’t let them live. You are aware of this,” he said hoarsely. “But I’ll make it quick. I promise. Just don’t do anything to catch attention.”

events.summary: 凯德在浴室替塔拉辛更衣时，报告了《强化安全法令》的内容与即将生效。
events.quote: “I managed to learn more about the Enhanced Security Decree while you were in Grand Bight,” Khaede said, fastening the ruby-studded clasps at the back of Talasyn’s dress.

events.summary: 凯德转述宫女的传闻，说南翼有人听见前夜皇后的歌声。
events.quote: “They hear someone singing on occasion. They think it’s the former Night Empress.”

events.summary: 刑场上塔拉辛站在前排，五十名被绑的萨多维安俘虏跪在地上。
events.quote: Alaric was only a few feet away from her, and so were the prisoners—all fifty of them, kneeling on the ground, hands tied behind their backs.

events.summary: 阿拉里克没有发表任何仪式性讲话，直接放出影刃处死了全部俘虏。
events.quote: Without uttering a single word of the ceremonial speech that was expected of him, Alaric sent the inky knives flying in all directions.

events.summary: 塔拉辛泪流满面，转身逃回飞艇离开平原。
events.quote: Talasyn turned and fled back to the airship that would ferry her across the plains to the Citadel.

relations.relation: 夫妻（夜皇与他的皇后，她实为萨多维安光织者）
relations.quote: If only he could hold his wife and let her smooth all the bad memories away.

relations.relation: 父子兼君臣；阿拉里克始终不敢公开违抗父亲
relations.quote: if my father tries to hurt you, I will have no choice but to stop him.

relations.relation: 女友兼密谋同伴；凯德不肯把全部计划告诉她
relations.quote: “By the way, Tal—after you get back from the plains, follow my lead, all right?”

relations.relation: 监视者/护卫；以萨多维安旧称 Lachis’ka 称呼她并警告她不许移开视线
relations.quote: “You can’t look away, Lachis’ka,” Ileis muttered as soon as she caught the turn of Talasyn’s head out of the corner of her eye.

relations.relation: 母子；母亲多年前弃他而去
relations.quote: This was how his mother had looked in the months before she left him.

numbers.context: 在平原上被处决的萨多维安俘虏人数
numbers.quote: all fifty of them, kneeling on the ground, hands tied behind their backs.

numbers.context: 聚集在刑场围观的士兵、平民与整支影锻军团人数
numbers.quote: The execution site was eerily silent despite the hundreds of people who had converged upon it.

numbers.context: 阿拉里克的影魔法凝成的弯刀数量
numbers.quote: collapsing into themselves to form dozens of curved blades, their serrated edges crackling with the silver static of aetherspace.

numbers.context: 刑场上阿拉里克与塔拉辛之间的距离
numbers.quote: The distance of several feet might as well have been an insurmountable chasm between them.

numbers.context: 塔拉辛被称呼的两套头衔（Lachis’ka 与夜国皇后）
numbers.quote: Two different titles. Two roles she couldn’t fulfill without letting go of something else—a murdered mother, a former allegiance.

notes: 语料问题：①标题重复——第1行与第12行都是“Chapter Twenty-Five”；②第2–11行及第130–141行为连续空行残留，正文实际从第15行开始；③第131–140行（鬼魂传闻段之后）有一大段空行把同一段落语境隔开；④本章含集体处决场面，摘要只记事实不复述暴力细节。
